events_detected.title: Iran war Day 181 — CEASEFIRE DIPLOMACY: Iran agrees to draw up conditions to reopen Strait of Hormuz, Qatari mediation active
events_detected.description: MAJOR DEVELOPMENT: Reuters/NBC/CBS report Iran war mediators have placed renewed emphasis on reopening Strait of Hormuz. Iran says any Hormuz understanding with US must include end to wars in Lebanon, Gaza, Syria. Iran dismissed latest US sanctions, urged global pushback. Tanker attacked Aug 27 off Oman. events_detected.title: DEVELOPMENT: WHO declares Uganda Ebola outbreak ENDED Aug 26 — DRC epidemic continues as 2nd largest in history
events_detected.description: POSITIVE DEVELOPMENT: WHO declared the end of Ebola disease outbreak in Uganda on Aug 26, following 42 days without a new confirmed case. Uganda recorded 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. WHO issued certificate recognising successful interruption of Ebola transmission. However, DRC epidemic continues — still the fastest-growing and 2nd largest Ebola outbreak on record. Bundibugyo strain (BDBV) complicates response as existing treatments certified for Zaire strain. WHO IHR Emergency Committee held second meeting Aug 18. MSF says communities still not receiving adequate support. Ugandan teams expanding DRC treatment centres.
events_detected.source: ECDC, WHO, Wikipedia, Galaxy FM Uganda, New Vision Uganda, CDC
events_detected.trend_change: PARTIAL IMPROVEMENT — Uganda front closed, DRC ongoing
